Once upon a time, there were three little pigs who set out into the world to build their own homes and make their way in life.

The First Little Pig
The first little pig was very lazy. He didn't want to work hard, so he quickly built his house out of straw. As soon as he finished, a Big Bad Wolf came along, smelled the pig inside, and knocked on the door.

"Little pig, little pig, let me come in!" the wolf demanded.
"Not by the hair of my chinny chin chin!" the first pig replied.
"Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house in!"

And with a massive breath, the wolf blew the straw house into pieces. The terrified little pig ran as fast as he could to his brother's house.

The Second Little Pig

The second little pig worked a little bit harder, but he was still in a hurry to go play, so he built his house out of sticks. The first pig had just arrived when the Big Bad Wolf showed up at the door.

"Little pigs, little pigs, let me come in!"
"Not by the hair of our chinny chin chins!"
"Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house in!"

The wolf took a deep breath and blew the stick house right down. The two little pigs squealed and sprinted all the way to their oldest brother's house.

The Third Little Pig
The third little pig was a hard worker. He had taken his time and built a strong, sturdy house out of **bricks**. The two frightened brothers rushed inside just before the Big Bad Wolf arrived. The wolf was very hungry by now and very confident.

"Little pigs, little pigs, let me come in!"
"Not by the hair of our chinny chin chins!"
"Then I'll huff, and I'll puff, and I'll blow your house in!"

The wolf huffed, and he puffed, and he blew as hard as he could. But the brick house didn't even shake. He huffed and puffed again and again, but the strong house stood tall.

Furious, the wolf decided to climb up to the roof and sneak down the chimney. But the clever third pig had anticipated this and placed a large pot of boiling water right under the fireplace. The Big Bad Wolf tumbled down the chimney, landed right in the hot water with a yelp, and ran out the door, never to bother the three little pigs again!

But he kinda throws me off a bit, I don't know why! Gakupo is better! Did you know Gakupo's katana isn't a solid boring colour of gray? He used to be included with the cryptonloid group, and so did Gumi. He's been updated around 3-4 times, for voicebanks, and a couple other that aren't really important to mention. His body jerked with each sob that was torn from him, his frame curling to bring himself closer. He held his face against the corpse's neck, just beneath the jawline, breathing in all that was left of Bokuto.
He had so many things he'd wanted to do with him, so many things he'd wanted to say, but all of those things seemed to have fallen away once the moment had finally come. Akashi wanted to scream, but he couldn't find his voice. Not even a sentence could get past his suffering.
He kept himself against Bokuto and held onto him with what little strength he had left in him.
He didn't get up to alert the nurses, or the doctors, or anyone in the hospital. He knew that once they found out, they would take Bokuto away from him.
